organisms-web-directory-templates.import:
import { FullLayout } from "@asu/shared";
import { WebDirectory } from "@asu/app-webdir-ui";

param: {Object} props - The props for configuring the WebDirectory component.
{"departments" | "faculty_rank" | "people" | "people_departments"} props.searchType - The type of web directory search (e.g., 'departments', 'people').
{string} props.ids - The IDs used for searching (e.g., department IDs, ASURITE IDs).
{string} props.deptIds - The department IDs for searching.
{string} props.API_URL - The API URL for performing the search.
{string} props.searchApiVersion - The version of the search API to use.
{string} props.profileURLBase - The base URL for profile links.
{string} props.appPathFolder - The base path for the application folder.
{Record<string, any>} props.display - Display options for the search results.
{string} props.alphaFilter - Indicates whether to enable alpha filtering.

organisms-web-directory-templates.description: React component for displaying web directory search results.
